_readme: Edit this one file. Photos go in the photos folder as 01.jpg to 24.jpg. Then run: python3 tools/build.py
headline: Twenty-four days of us
welcome_message: Biscuit here. I have been put in charge of deliveries until Christmas. One a day, from 1 December.
